footer.tagline: ReLoop — no donation reaches a dead end.
footer.honesty: Recycling settlements are simulated and masses are estimates.

errors.unreachable: The server didn't answer. Check that the backend is running, then try again.

location.tapToPlace: Tap the map to drop a pin
location.pinned: Pin at {lat}, {lng} — drag it to adjust
location.geoFailed: Your browser couldn't share your location. Drop the pin by hand instead.

landing.subtitle: The jacket your child outgrew can keep another warm this winter. The books on your shelf can fill a classroom. ReLoop finds the people who need what you no longer use — and if no one can use it, sees that it's recycled, not binned.

trust.private: Address shared only after a yes

need.title: It goes where it's needed
need.text: Organisations are ranked by what they've actually asked for, how urgently, and how close they are — so your gift lands where it matters most.

deadEnd.title: A “no” is never the end
deadEnd.text: If one place can't take it, the next best one is asked. If no one can, it's recycled — your donation still counts.

journey.title: You see where it goes
journey.text: From the moment you list it to the moment it's received, every step is recorded and shown to you.

landing.becomesTitle: Small things, given well, change someone's day.

clothes.to: A warm winter for a child
clothes.text: Coats, uniforms and everyday wear go to homes and shelters that have listed them as a need.

toys.text: Games and toys in good shape find their way to the children who'll love them next.

books.to: A fuller shelf in a classroom
books.text: Schools and reading rooms in your city put them back into readers' hands.

landing.statement: The most sustainable thing you own is the thing that already exists.
landing.statementText: Every item reused is one less made and one less thrown away. ReLoop keeps good things in use for as long as they last — and recovers the material when they can't be.

textile.text: of textile waste is generated in India every year. 58% of it is post-consumer: the clothes households finish with.
textile.source: Ministry of Textiles, Mapping of Textile Waste Value Chain in India, 2026

postConsumer.text: of post-consumer textile waste is not diverted from landfill.

unaccounted.text: of India's municipal solid waste is unaccounted — neither processed nor landfilled.

list.title: Snap and list
list.text: Tell us what it is, add a photo, and drop a pin for pickup.

choose.title: Choose who receives it
choose.text: See the organisations that need it most, and why — then pick one.

handover.title: Hand it over
handover.text: They collect, or you drop it off. Then watch it reach its next home.

landing.orgTitle: Tell us what you need. We'll bring it to you.
landing.orgText: List what your organisation needs and how urgently. You'll receive offers that match — nearby, and yours to accept or decline. A donor's address is shared with you only once you accept.
landing.ctaTitle: Give your things a second life.
landing.ctaText: List your first donation in a few minutes. Someone nearby could use exactly what you're about to give away.

auth.asideQuote: A rejection is a transition, not an ending.

asidePoints.one: Ranked matches with reasons you can read
asidePoints.two: Your address is shared only after an organisation accepts
asidePoints.three: Every item ends in reuse or recovery

auth.badCredentials: That email and password don't match an account.
auth.donorCardText: Clothes, toys or books in good shape. We'll find who needs them.
auth.orgCardText: NGOs, shelters, schools and homes: receive offers that match your needs.
auth.adminNote: Admin accounts are created by the platform operator, not here.
auth.donorSubtitle: You'll be able to list your first item straight away.
auth.donorPrivacy: Your pickup address is shown to an organisation only after it accepts your donation, and every release is recorded.
auth.orgSubtitle: One login per organisation. You'll receive offers once an admin verifies you.
auth.orgFixedNote: Name and registration ID can't be changed after registration.
auth.orgLocationNote: Drop a pin where donations should go. Donors see only an approximate position until you accept their donation.
auth.orgPendingNote: New organisations start as pending. Only verified organisations receive offers.

fields.storageCapacityHint: How many items you can hold at once — a count, not kilograms.
fields.pickupCapableHint: Turn off if donors must bring items to you.
fields.addressHint: As you'd write it for a visitor. The pin, not this text, sets the location.
fields.quantityHint: A count of items, e.g. 12 shirts.
fields.noteHint: Sizes, age range, anything that helps them decide.
fields.priorityHint: Moves your offer up in organisations' inboxes. It doesn't change who is ranked first.

donor.intro: Every item you list is followed until it is reused or recycled.
donor.emptyText: List clothes, toys or books, and ReLoop will rank the organisations that need them.

donation.awaitingAnswer: Waiting for {org} to answer — the offer expires {when}.
donation.photoFailed: Your donation was listed, but the photos weren't uploaded
donation.escalatedText: Choose what happens next with the buttons above.
donation.windowAdvisory: The pickup window is a preference shown to organisations, not a deadline.
donation.addressPrivacy: Only you can see this. An organisation sees it only after accepting, and each release is recorded.

holder.title: Who's receiving it
holder.dropoffOnly: They don't collect: please drop it off.
holder.privacy: Shared with you while this organisation holds your donation.

newDonation.title: List an item

conditionHelp.NEW: Unused, tags or packaging may be on.
conditionHelp.GENTLY_USED: Worn or read a little, no damage.

newDonation.whereTitle: Where should it be picked up?
newDonation.whereText: Drop a pin on the map. Organisations see only a rounded distance until one accepts.
newDonation.whenText: A preference shown to organisations; the exact time is agreed after acceptance.
newDonation.photosText: Organisations decide on condition, so a clear photo helps. Location data is removed on upload.
newDonation.nextHint: Next you'll see a ranked list of organisations, with the reasons behind each ranking.

images.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Metadata such as GPS is stripped when uploaded.

candidates.title: Choose who gets the first offer
candidates.subtitle: Ranked by distance, declared need, urgency, storage space and reliability. Open a card to see why.
candidates.alreadyOffered: This donation has already been offered. This list is a preview only.

declines.one: 1 decline so far: the search has widened
declines.other: {count} declines so far: the search has widened

candidates.emptyTitle: No organisation in range right now
candidates.emptyText: Continuing will bring the decision back to you: you can redirect it to recycling or cancel.
candidates.howScored: Each score is a weighted sum of the factors shown. The weights are set by the platform for now; they will be calibrated once enough accept and decline history exists.

score.contributionHint: Points this factor adds, out of its weight

reason.noNeed: no declared need for this category
reason.noHistory: no offer history yet — neutral score

actions.reasonHint: Recorded in the donation's audit trail.

rematch.label: Re-match
rematch.confirm: Offer it to the next best organisation.

upgradePriority.label: Upgrade to priority
upgradePriority.confirm: Mark it as priority and offer it to the next best organisation. Priority donations rise in organisations' inboxes.

recycle.label: Send to recycling
recycle.confirm: Route it to the nearest recycling partner for this category. If none is in range, it goes to the admin queue.

dropoff.label: I'll drop it off
dropoff.confirm: Choose when you'll take it to the organisation.

handedOver.label: I've handed it over
handedOver.confirm: Confirm that the organisation now has your items.

cancel.label: Cancel donation
cancel.confirm: The donation is withdrawn (it is kept in your history). Any open offer is withdrawn too.

accept.label: Accept
accept.confirm: Accepting releases the donor's exact pickup address to you, and the release is recorded.

reject.label: Decline
reject.confirm: You won't be offered this donation again. It moves on to the next organisation.

confirmReceipt.label: Confirm receipt
confirmReceipt.confirm: Confirm you've received the items. This completes the donation.

requeue.label: Re-queue
requeue.confirm: Send it back into matching: it is offered to the next eligible organisation.

adminRecycle.confirm: Route it to the nearest recycling partner for this category.

confirmRecycled.label: Confirm recycled
confirmRecycled.confirm: Confirm on the recycler's behalf (simulated). A simulated settlement over estimated mass is recorded.

recycling.simulatedNote: Simulated: no money moves yet. Wallet credit arrives in a later phase.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Updates on donations you're part of. Checked every {seconds} seconds while ReLoop is open.
notifications.emptyText: You'll see offers, answers and status changes here.

notify.STALL: {item} moved to the admin queue after no progress
notify.NO_RECYCLER: No recycler can take {item}; it's in the admin queue
notify.REQUEUE: {item} returned to matching by an admin

placeholder.title: Coming in the next part of this phase
placeholder.text: This area (the organisation dashboard, admin panel and discovery map) is not built yet. It is a labelled stub until the second half of Phase 3.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: That address doesn't lead anywhere in ReLoop.

EscalationCause.THRESHOLD_REACHED: Several organisations in a row declined it.
EscalationCause.NO_CANDIDATES: No eligible organisation is in range right now.
EscalationCause.NOT_OFFERED: It was listed for a while without being offered.
